name: sonner
title: Sonner Toaster
description: A notification card that appears near the bottom of the screen with a status icon, a short title and a line of detail. Trigger buttons in the demo fire plain, success, error and loading versions.
use: A short-lived confirmation or failure notice that should not interrupt what the user is doing.
avoid: Notifications disappear on a timer, so anything the user must act on needs a different pattern.
a11y: The engine marks messages as status updates, but they auto-dismiss and cannot be reached or closed from the keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark card floats near the bottom of an empty black stage, showing a small red-ringed exclamation icon at the left, a bold Upload failed line and a dimmer sentence underneath. The card has a thin border and soft shadow.
behaves: Firing the error action fades a toast in at the bottom; frames four to six catch it part-way and then fully settled. It holds in place over the empty stage and leaves on its own timer.
customise: The wrapper forwards its props to the notification engine and colours come from CSS variables; each message's title and description are passed when you fire it.
weight: light: A thin wrapper around a notification engine, idle whenever no message is showing.
demo: Buttons labelled Show Toast, Success, Error and Promise; the toast reads Upload failed.
issues: The first three frames show only the demo buttons, so the notification itself is missing for most of the clip.
polishWhy: Clean rounded toast with clear icon and text hierarchy, but it is the standard notification look.
